key_impacts: 198 people were killed during the November 2009 rains and floods in El Salvador
In Fenadesal Sur, 14 inches of rain fell in four hours, swelling the Acelhuate River which ripped away bridges and obliterated homes
In Fenadesal Sur, 30 houses were destroyed and more than 100 were damaged
About 300 residents in at-risk homes in Fenadesal Sur evacuated to safety
In Aragon, riverside communities were evacuated; no houses in Aragon were flooded during the November storm
